minutes.headline: Superintendent proposed staff cuts to close a gap to the 2.5 percent guideline, including phasing out French; vote set for April
minutes.summary: Public comment was dominated by students, teachers and residents objecting to cutting foreign language, especially French. The superintendent and business administrator presented the FY20 budget gap and the list of proposed cuts, and explained how health insurance and other changes lowered the requested increase. The committee approved a line item transfer and prior minutes, waived second reading of two policies, then went into executive session. The budget vote is expected in April after the Finance Committee meeting.

what_happened.line: The superintendent and business administrator presented the FY20 budget gap and a list of proposed staff cuts, including phasing out French, to reach the 2.5 percent guideline.
The requested increase fell from an earlier figure, mainly because health insurance came in lower; transportation and retirements were also adjusted.
The committee voted to approve a line item transfer at the Primary School, moving money from office supplies to classroom supplies.
The committee waived second reading of policies 5402 and 5406; the vote passed.
The superintendent is to return April 3 for a budget vote, and the school choice seat vote was deferred to the second March meeting.

why_it_matters: The proposed cuts would change which courses students can take, since French would be phased out, and the budget the committee votes on sets the school share of the town budget, mostly taxes.
Public comment at the meeting centered on foreign language, so the final list of cuts in April may differ from what was presented.
